title.justification: The title is directly presented at the beginning of the paper.

analysis.description: The paper introduces Advantage Alignment, a family of algorithms designed to perform efficient and intuitive opponent shaping in general-sum games. It proves that existing methods, LOLA and LOQA, implicitly perform Advantage Alignment and demonstrates effectiveness in social dilemmas achieving state-of-the-art results.

type.justification: The paper primarily focuses on introducing and theoretically grounding algorithms based on first principles, as well as proving properties of existing methods.
